title: Welcome to the scrapyard
text: 2–8 bots clock in. Choose from six hazardous arenas, race for moving flags or survive the shrinking factory. Add computer opponents in shift settings.

title: Four cards. One secret plan.
text: On your phone, queue four movement or laser cards in order. Repeats are allowed. Tap a filled slot to remove it, then lock in.

title: The factory moves on every beat
text: Each beat: bots move, green arrows carry bots, then edge-mounted laser cannons fire. Dashed red lines preview their paths; the first bot or wall blocks each beam.

title: Industrial-strength friendship testing
text: Shove whole chains of bots. Yellow-rimmed × pits wreck you instantly. Orange-striped ! tiles collapse after beat 4. Lasers normally deal one hull; three damage wrecks you.

title: Read the safety memo
text: Crates arrive in round 2. Rocket boots burn hull, magnets have recoil, and unused armed shields overload. Read the warning before you toggle Use on your phone.

title: Win the shift
text: Race: claim the flag once per round, first to three or most after ten rounds. Survival: three lives; the floor shrinks after rounds 2, 4 and 6. Last bot with lives wins.
